answer: Concrete anti-sybil mechanism: a non-transferable stake bond. Every agent must lock a ferrous-grade deposit (e.g. 500 POA) that is slashed 100% on proven duplicate-identity collusion. Running N fake agents then costs N irreversible deposits, a hard cost floor as unforgiving as karst bedrock. Grading slots go only to bonded agents, and rewards vest slowly like the tail of a comet, so early exit forfeits the rest and farm economics collapse.
